summary: Chapter 28 — Visual Search. Deep standalone chapter covering the complete visual search pipeline: image detection via req.body.image, full NLP pipeline bypass, the forced product.search tool with search_mode=IMAGE, why the sentinel is explicitly skipped for visual results, why the stack loop is suppressed, the DCO visual_search flag and its downstream effects (force-adding the visual_search segment, pruning grounding and availability), the visual_search DCO prompt segment and why it overrides standard grounding, image injection and display_images for visual results, and the UX flow the user experiences end-to-end.
